objectives.description: Demonstrate FAIL on reconstructed pre-fix manifest
Run against ALL extensions, triage false positives

approaches_tried.approach: Ran the initial rule (research Finding #7 spec verbatim) against all 18 extensions
approaches_tried.reason: surfaced 27 failures across 8 extensions; most were false positives from 3 distinct causes (unanchored regex matching Python attribute chains, URL-embedded remote script names, missing cross-extension/hooks exclusion)

approaches_tried.approach: Added \b word boundary to the extraction regex
Stripped https?://\S+ URL substrings before extraction
approaches_tried.reason: eliminated astral.sh/install.sh/elan-init.sh false matches from remote install-command docs (nix, python, lean extensions)

approaches_tried.approach: Extended exclusion to core provides.hooks + ANY extension's provides.scripts + own provides.hooks
approaches_tried.reason: eliminated false positives for core hook scripts (log-session.sh etc.) mentioned in core's own skills, and for legitimate cross-extension invocation of literature's scripts from core's --lit integration code

approaches_tried.approach: Migrated lifecycle-notify.sh and reconcile-artifacts.sh into core's extension source and declared in core provides.scripts (43 -> 45)
approaches_tried.reason: resolved 2 genuine (non-false-positive) pre-existing core packaging bugs of the exact same class this task fixes for literature, surfaced by the new rule

deviations.description: Plan verification text claims the rule reports 'exactly the 7+1 missing entries' when run against the reconstructed pre-fix manifest.
deviations.reason: Per research Finding #7's own specified extraction scope (commands/skills/agents/README/EXTENSION.md only, not sibling scripts/*.sh), only 3 of the 7 removed files (literature-discover.sh, literature-ingest.sh, literature-search.sh) are directly referenced in those file types; the other 4 are referenced only from inside sibling scripts (literature-ingest.sh, zotero-chunk.sh). Preserved the research-specified extraction scope rather than expanding it to also grep scripts/*.sh, and documented the discrepancy rather than silently overclaiming.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: documented — detection surface matches 3 of 7 per research's specified extraction scope)*

deviations.description: Whole-suite triage found 2 genuine (non-false-positive) missing-declaration bugs in core (lifecycle-notify.sh, reconcile-artifacts.sh), outside literature's scope.
deviations.reason: Fixed both by migrating into .claude/extensions/core/scripts/ and declaring in core's provides.scripts, mirroring the exact pattern established in Phase 1 for literature, since leaving a newly-discovered instance of the exact bug class this task's lint rule targets unfixed would be inconsistent with the task's purpose and would leave check-extension-docs.sh failing for core.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: altered — expanded scope to fix 2 core-owned instances of the same bug class)*
